1.heading: AM 3416, BC 588 Title
refs: Dr. Delaney supposes that this Psalm was written by David on occasion of his war with the Ammonites, in consequence of the indignities shewn to his messengers
but it is more probable that it was written to bewail the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple.
Heb. God of revenges, O God. Deut 32:35 , 41 , 42
